editorial:
Imagine sitting in a boring high school class when a student suddenly takes over. That is exactly how things kick off here. You meet Vendela, a girl who is obsessed with becoming a famous YouTuber. She decides to prank her class and her teacher, Lukas, by playing a video that is way more disturbing than anyone expected. The whole vibe feels like a tense game of cat and mouse. It starts out looking like a typical school drama, but it quickly turns into a scary situation where the teacher starts to truly fear for his life. It captures that weird energy of social media fame and how far some kids will go to get views.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing. The acting feels real, and the pacing is quick enough that you won't get bored. While some parts might feel a bit slow at first, the twists make up for it. If you enjoy stories about power struggles and mean teens, you will love this one. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick if you want something different from the usual jump-scare movies.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a shocking reveal about Vendela's true intentions. It turns out the entire ordeal was a carefully planned performance for her online followers. She manipulated Lukas and her classmates to create the perfect viral moment. The twist shows that she does not actually care about the people she hurt; she only cares about the fame. In the end, the power shifts completely to her, leaving the adults feeling helpless and broken.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about social media obsession.
